new_claim: A delta-tight frame of traceless Hermitian directions with unit normalized HS norm and operator norm <=M forces signed-state broadcasting error >= a[d^2(1-2delta)-d]/[4M(d^2-1)]. Haar-conjugated involutions form such frames with N=O(d^2 log d) by matrix Chernoff; the resulting experiment has fixed sandwich, exact bounded Holevo capacity, accessible information O(1/d), but b2 remains bounded below.
primary_import: Tropp, User-Friendly Tail Bounds for Sums of Random Matrices, arXiv:1004.4389v7, Theorem 1.1 (matrix Chernoff). All broadcasting, Choi, entropy, and accessible-information calculations are derived in the report.
verification_scope: Random-frame diagnostic used NumPy QR prototypes for d=2,4,8 with modest sample counts. It checked finite frame coordinates only; it did not verify the asymptotic Chernoff event. No SDP or large computation was used.
cost_boundary: The mathematical random family has O(d^2 log d) dense directions; exact Haar generation, finite-bit compilation, efficient acquisition, apparatus and energy costs are not established.
cross_phase: Read c05_s01-s03, assigned c05_l01-l10, and adjacent broadcasting c04_s01-s03. Attributed consequences and boundaries are recorded in revisions/CROSS_PHASE_AUDIT.txt.
remaining_gate: Find an actual growing-dimensional selfcompatible experiment sequence with b2->0 and eEB bounded below, or prove the dimension-free CP-range-to-EB lift. Neither is resolved here.
